name: Nest Wisdom Vault
oneLiner: nWISDOM is a Nest vault share backed mainly by WisdomTree Connect tokenized fund exposure (xCRDYX), accruing yield through NAV rather than a hard $1 peg.
collateral: Predominantly WisdomTree Private Credit and Alternative Income Digital Fund tokenised shares (xCRDYX), which hold publicly-traded alternative credit vehicles (BDCs, closed-end credit funds and mortgage REITs) tracking the Gapstow index, plus a small Nest Treasury Vault (nTBILL) position and a stablecoin (pUSD / USDC) liquidity buffer for redemptions
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and accretes through underlying WisdomTree fund NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Nest retains issuer / admin authority over vault shares with permissioned issuance and freeze surfaces beyond reserve-only exposure.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nWISDOM is a Nest BoringVault share whose ERC20 (identical CREATE2 address 0x29bf...0240 on Plume and Ethereum) contains no LayerZero code itself. Cross-chain movement runs through Plume's SkyLink on LayerZero's OVault standard, orchestrated by the Plume-side NestVaultComposer (LayerZero OVaultComposer, 0x312a0219...). Plume is the canonical accounting/settlement hub. Per LayerZero's OVault Share mesh design, vault shares move via a ShareOFTAdapter (lockbox) on the hub chain plus standard ShareOFT mint/burn on spokes, with deposits/redemptions routed through the hub ERC-4626 vault (ABA pattern). This is an external LayerZero OFT-Adapter/lockbox route with a third-party control surface (composer + OFT peers), not a pure validated-network burn/mint, so it maps to external-lock-mint. The specific adapter contract and the named DVN set were not enumerated, hence probable rather than verified.

protocols.note: Nest cross-chain doc: vault share movement via LayerZero OFT burn/mint messaging; Plume is the canonical accounting hub, Ethereum/Solana are spokes. No lock/mint adapter.

protocols.note: Ethereum token is a plain BoringVault ERC20 (enter()/exit(), authority access control, no LayerZero code in-token); identical CREATE2 address on Plume signals omnichain token standard with OFT logic in composer/peer layer.

notices.title: NAV-style dollar asset
notices.message: nWISDOM is a Nest vault share whose value tracks the underlying WisdomTree fund book. It behaves like a vault share rather than a hard 1:1 par stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: nWISDOM is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs WisdomTree-fund allocation. Both Teller and Manager are owned by the same Nest 3-of-6 Safe.
